template.p: Odoo empowers you to manage every aspect of your construction projects effortlessly and efficiently, and its integrated applications ensure unparalleled success and client satisfaction.
The construction industries come in two parts:
A streamlined industry package for companies focused on simple jobs, rapid quoting, and efficient execution.
It covers essential quoting, basic project setup, straightforward planning, material coordination, and smooth on-site delivery.
Ideal for teams seeking operational efficiency without unnecessary complexity.
A complete solution tailored for construction companies overseeing complex and multi-trade projects.
It delivers fine-tuned estimation tools, subcontractor management, advanced planning, materials forecasting, progress driven billing.
Perfect for companies needing structured workflows and high-precision project management.
The module comes on top of the Construction Builder setup providing additional capabilities.

li.p: CRM App: Track incoming leads from initial client inquiry to site visits and quote requests, keeping all prospect discussions organized in a single pipeline.

Sales App: Quickly generate detailed construction estimates using reusable quotation templates, section templates and bill of materials, enabling online client sign-offs and seamless conversion into sales orders.
Project App: Manage construction sites as projects, organizing tasks into stages like "Foundation," "Framing," and "Finishing" with clear deadlines.
Timesheets App: Track labour hours accurately with a mobile app that allows workers to log time against specific tasks or cost codes on-site.
Purchase App: Automate the procurement of building materials, managing RFQs and purchase orders to ensure timely delivery to the site.
Inventory App: Keep track of materials, tools, equipment, and consumables across multiple sites or warehouses, reducing loss and theft.
Invoicing App: Handle complex billing scenarios like milestone invoicing, down payments, and retention based on project progress.
Documents App: Centralize blueprints, contracts, and permits, ensuring that the latest versions are always available to the team.

template.h5: Scale recurrent work with section templates
template.p: Stop rebuilding complex material and labor mixtures from scratch for every new estimate. By defining standardized unit blocks, such as 1m² of finished flooring, you can insert them directly into any quote and scale all nested component quantities instantly by adjusting the section quantity.

ul.li: Create a new quotation or open an existing draft.
Add a section line and choose one of your preconfigured section templates from the database (e.g. Brick Wall Partition, High-End Parquet Flooring, or Commercial Cooking Hub).
Enter your total required target volume or unit count directly into the Quantity field of the section header line.
Watch as all nested component lines underneath (raw materials and labour) automatically scale proportionally to meet your project's exact scope.

template.h5: First quote in record time leveraging the bill of materials (Construction Developer)
template.p:
Making sure you don't waste time generating quotes which may never be signed is paramount to run your business efficiently.
To help you with this aspects, we configured the Sales App with bill of materials to be leveraged straight from quotation form.

ul.li: Generate a new quotation and select the Carport Construction template.
Adjust quantities according to customer needs.

Fine tune each product bill of material clicking the magic wand.
You're all set to send a first quote to your customer!
Prior sending your quote, always hit the Check Cost Changes to ensure to secure your margin when costs go up or remain competitive when they go down.
Iterate as needed until your customer approves the order, then confirm it!

template.p: Once confirmed, the sales order exposes various useful smart buttons at your fingertips which we'll come back to in the next sections.

Import your bill of materials database in few clicks leveraging Odoo csv import and export.

template.p:

We got you covered here with the quote calculator!

ul.li: Generate a new quotation and select the Renovation Project template.
Open the quote calculator from the smart buttons.

Assuming there will be manual labour behind every product from the quote, start filling the time estimate for some of them.
The total labour time and even time for project management and purchases are computed accordingly...

Save the calculator and come back to your quote.
The Labour & Project Follow-up section has been updated in consequence!

Construction may not always go as planned and quotations may be built based on estimates. The question when it takes more time or consumes more material due to erroneous estimates is who owns the risk?
To help you with that, the construction industry comes with a contract type which helps you clarify any upfront issue, directly in your quote.

ul.li: Create a new quotation / sale order, assign a customer and select a quotation template to save time.
Open the Other Info tab and in the Invoicing section, adjust the Contract Type per your needs.
When selecting Per Line, a new column is exposed for you to specify for each lines the contract type.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3

o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3

template.p: Do your construction projects go always according to plan? If not, here is how to handle change orders and extras.

ul.li: Open the project for which you want to introduce a change order.
Click the Sale Orders shortcut from the top bar.
Here click "New" and adjust the sale order details as needed.
On confirmation, the sale order is associated to your project!

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-warning pb-0 pt-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3
div.p: When selling change orders, make sure not to use service products creating new projects to keep things in order in a single project.

template.p: In some countries, specific tax discount may apply in construction. To handle this, you can use the fiscal position and adjust by which tax replacing one. Assigning the applicable fiscal position to your customer will make sure to use the appropriate taxes!

ul.li: From the Invoicing app Configuration menu, open the Fiscal Positions.
Create a new fiscal position, give it a name and assign the applicable country.
Open now the Taxes still from the configuration menu.
Create a new tax or select the applicable one if existing in your localisation package.
Configure it as needed in terms of amount and assign it to your newly created fiscal position.
If properly setup, the Replaces field is displayed and can be populated with the taxes this tax replaces in this fiscal position.
In the Advanced Options tab, adjust the label, country and assign or create a tax group for it.
Open the contact form of your contact eligible to the tax discount associated to this fiscal position.
In the Sales & Purchase tab, select the applicable fiscal position.

template.p: Capturing remarks during on-site visits and easily following up on them is paramount for clarity with stakeholders and workers.

ul.li:

Create one remark project per construction project to ensure traceability.
From project updates, navigate to the Remarks tab, add as many remarks as needed with the corresponding details.

Alternatively, open the remarks, from the Reporting menu of the Project App, to access them all (filter by project for more clarity).

template.h5: On site stock and delivery (Construction Developer)

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-warning pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3
div.p: This capability is configured only with products sold with bill of materials and for product component inventory tracked.

template.p:
The products supported by bills of materials are configured to be delivered directly to the customer on processing of the manufacturing orders.
In other words, the need for components are captured on customer working site location, which you can decide how to fulfill.
As a worksite manager, I decide the timing of onsite deliveries.

ul.li: From the Inventory app, open the operation replenishment view.
Select the worksite location to focus on from the filter drawer on the left hand side.

Select each product needed at a given moment and hit the order button at the top of the screen to plan a delivery from your warehouse.
As a result, a need would be created in the warehouse and a transfer you can adjust the date for.

Alternatively, you can select on specific product lines the Buy route to directly generate a request for quotation for onsite delivery to your supplier.
This is very handy for products like concrete for instance. Don't forget to define your vendors in the product form to leverage this.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3
div.p: Worksite locations are accounted in your inventory valuation!

template.p: As an inventory manager, I ensure just in time supplies.

ul.li: With all worksite needs fulfilled, the replenishment view allows me to capture the needs in the warehouse.
The forecast icon gives me the timeline of consumption for the coming months I have to meet.

Similarly to worksite managers, for all those needs, I can select them and trigger request for quotations to suppliers.
By default the order action from the warehouse is the creation or update of request for quotation.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3
div.div: Leaving the hand to worksite manager on their planning and centralizing the needs at the warehouse enables to order in bulk for all worksites at ones!

template.p:
In some cases, suppliers may have products with heavily volatile prices.
So that you can at best compute project costs during quoting, you need most up to date product costs.
We setup an automation so that your product costs and purchase opportunities reflect your last purchases as follow:

ul.li: On vendor bill confirmation.
On purchase order confirmation.
The product cost gets updated.
The vendor price list accounts for this new price in product Purchase tab to capture better deals (on cost and quantity).

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3 ps-3 pe-3
o_editor_banner_content w-100 px-3
div.div: This allows in preparation quotations to rely on most recent costs with the Check Cost Changes button in record time!

Add lines for missing projects and tasks.
Fill in the grid view day by day to capture spent time.

template.p: As site manager, on the other hand, you might record time for your whole team at the end of the week.

ul.li: Open the Timesheets App and reach the All Timesheets view.
Add lines for missing employees, projects and tasks.
Fill in the grid view day by day to capture spent time the same way.

template.p: Capturing data is great but leveraging it is better.

ul.li: From your Timesheets App, you have access to reports to understand where time was spent by employee, project, task and billing type.
A sale order with product invoicing based on timesheets gives you as well an idea of where you stand comparing the allocated time in the quantity column and the spent time in the delivered one.
From a project involving product invoicing based on timesheets, shortcuts in the top bar and smart buttons in the project form allow you to quickly capture time consumption.

You may want to keep things simple and simply split your invoices based on agreed upon terms.

ul.li: Define your products as services with fixed price.

The time sheet do not only help you to keep track of your costs, they as well are the lever to charge your customers.

ul.li: Define your products as services creating tasks and with an invoicing policy based on time sheets.
Record time spent on tasks as detailed in 🔍 Accurately track the time spent.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3

div.p: Timesheets to validate are then waiting for managers in the Timesheets App prior being expensable.

template.p: You may want to formalize the project progress through milestones and bill reached ones.

Come back to the task view and switch to its list view.
Expose the Milestone column from the parameter (🎚️) button at then end of the list title line.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-success pb-0 pt-3

template.h5: Streamlined delivery for progress management (Construction Developer)
template.p: Typically, products might be priced in a scalable fashion and billed based on delivered quantity, allowing invoicing of partially delivered order lines.

Select lines and trigger the Deliver button to account for this increment in delivered count.
